ledger: Waitress (light blue shirt, white apron, glasses on chest, hair in bun) | wiping counter at night under artificial light | standing by window at sunrise watching, then wiping/clearing counter in bright daylight | wipes counter with cloth, pours coffee from carafe, serves plate, sits on stool with customer, clears mugs/plate, handles money

Diner counter + red stools | empty counter with condiments at night | empty sunlit counter at dawn | provides support for wiping, sitting, holding mugs/plates/money; stools support seated weight

Coffee carafe (glass) + white ceramic mug | carafe full on warmer, mug empty on counter | mugs held at counter then cleared | waitress grips carafe handle -> pours stream into mug -> sets carafe down; customer grips mug

Plated food (fried egg, toast/pancake) | not yet on counter / in kitchen pass | on counter steaming before customer, then removed | carried one-handed, placed on counter, supported, later picked up by waitress

Semi-truck | white cab idling at night with exhaust/steam | dark green Kenworth box truck parked in daylight | stationary, exhaust emission, later approached and boarded by driver; supports weight on ground
US currency (folded $100 bills) | not on counter | placed on counter next to mug then left | hand establishes contact, presses/slides bills, releases
